_README: STAGED settings.json snippet for the Fable runtime cap (do NOT let an agent arm settings.json).
Apply BOTH pieces below into $HOME/.claude/settings.json (or the project .claude/settings.json)
by hand. This closes the interactive Fable bypass: it pins the session-OPENING model to Sonnet
and arms the SessionStart guard that loudly warns when an interactive session is on Fable over-cap.
Sonnet (not Opus) is the opening pin per the session model cadence (CLAUDE.md, Session Phase
Entry): sessions open in plan mode on Sonnet to structure the first brainstorm message into a
plan; /model opus is the deliberate escalation for ratifying a genuinely hard plan (Fable only
under a docs/fable-allotment.md acceptance receipt); execution drops back to /model sonnet and
fans out to the tiered fleet. The harness has no per-message model routing (verified 2026-08-07:
hooks cannot switch models), so the opening pin + this guard + the SessionEnd workflow-guard
audit are the three enforceable layers.
NOTE the pin is a DEFAULT, not a lock: /model persists ('saved as your default for new sessions')
to a harness-internal store no predicate can read. So piece (1) below is optional — typing
`/model sonnet` once sets the same opening tier with no paste. Piece (2), the guard hook, is the
part that actually needs this file, because a later /model opus silently re-arms an expensive
default for every future session and leaves no artifact behind.
1) Set the top-level default model to the opening tier:
"model": "sonnet"
2) ADD the guard command to the EXISTING SessionStart hook array (append, do not replace the
session-orient entry already there). The command below is the exact validated block.
After pasting, verify with: scripts/verify-fable-gate.sh
